subject.title: fix(proxy-capture): time out stalled CONNECT upstreams

question: Should debug proxy CONNECT attempts that have not established within 30 seconds now fail with HTTP 504 rather than remain pending indefinitely?
rationale: The implementation and proof support the bounded behavior, but choosing a fixed opening deadline changes the runtime contract for slow or blackholed upstreams and is not settled by tests alone.

options.title: Accept the bounded opening deadline
options.body: Merge after rebasing and passing the exact-head gates, treating 30 seconds as the intended debug-proxy opening budget.

options.title: Choose a different contract
options.body: Request a different timeout budget or an explicitly configurable policy if debug-proxy users need longer upstream establishment windows.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded opening deadline
recommendation.body: Merge after rebasing and passing the exact-head gates, treating 30 seconds as the intended debug-proxy opening budget.
